name: Press-Switch
source:
The game follows the view point of Calvin Hintre, a junior in high school who, by sheer luck, stumbles over a device capable of performing many reality defying abilities. Intrigued by the concept, Calvin and his choices pave the way on how he will use the device, who he will use them on or with and the results of his or their actions. Will he be lead to decipher the many questions that would once be forever unanswered or will he simply fall into the depths of his carnal desires? The result is up to the player.

[From [url=http://www.tfgamessite.com/index.php?module=viewgame&id=282]official site[/url]]
translation:
游戏以卡尔文·辛特雷 (Calvin Hintre) 的视角为背景，他是一名高中三年级学生，纯粹是运气好，偶然发现了一种能够执行许多挑战现实能力的设备。卡尔文对这个概念很感兴趣，他和他的选择为他将如何使用该设备、他将在谁身上或与谁一起使用以及他或他们的行为结果铺平了道路。他会被引导解开许多曾经永远没有答案的问题，还是会陷入肉体欲望的深渊？结果取决于玩家。

[来自[url=http://www.tfgamessite.com/index.php?module=viewgame&id=282]官方网站[/url]]
